exact_statement: For every actual Boolean coordinate split g,h on a finite uniform cube, let u=(ghat+hhat)/2, v=(ghat-hhat)/2, E={T:v_T!=0}, d=sum v_T^2 and rho=sum_E(u_T^2+v_T^2). Signed Parseval cancellation gives sum_E ghat(T)^2=sum_E hhat(T)^2=rho. For d>0 the normalized carrier sector law has mutual information mu>=0 and B_i=rho h2(d/rho)-rho mu<=rho h2(d/rho)<=d log2(e rho/d); for d=0 all quantities vanish. The child-measured bound fails for the normalized non-Boolean vector (12/13,-5/13), with d=25/169 and proposed child rho=49/169. Boolean tensors and dummy embeddings preserve local quantities. For f_n=1-2 indicator{x=0}, every complete tree has carrier rho=1 on each active node and its carrier-envelope excess C_K/I >= (1/n)sum_{j=1}^n(j-1-K)_+, unbounded for every fixed K, while the true D_4 excess is zero. The true joint-credit stopping-tree bill D_K obeys [H-H_leaf-(K+2/ln2)(I-I_leaf)]_+<=D_K<=H-H_leaf; hence complete-tree some-order and every-order finite linear bounds are both equivalent to FEI. No universal influence payment is proved.

exact_statement: Let A=(g+h)/2,V=(g-h)/2,F=A+iV for an actual Boolean split, u=Ahat,v=Vhat,d=Inf_i, and M_i be the mutual information of the spectral-sector law with masses u_T^2,v_T^2. Full Booleanity gives F^4=1 and I(F^2)/2=W_i=2 sum_(U nonempty)|U|(sum_T v_T v_(T xor U))^2. With R_i=W_i-d log2(1/d)>=0 and sigma(d)=log2(e)d-(1-d)log2(1/(1-d))>=0, B_i=W_i+log2(e)d-R_i-M_i-sigma(d). In particular B_i+M_i<=W_i+log2(e)d; this bound fails for the normalized non-Boolean coefficient vector (4/5,3/5). In any bound B_i<=alpha I(F^2)+C d valid for all Boolean splits with fixed finite C, necessarily alpha>=1/2, as witnessed by even-dimensional bent one-point phase surgery.
